data_fields.name: minimap_side_px
data_fields.donor_constant: user setting m_minimap_size x split-screen factor x min(frame w,h)/480

data_fields.name: bounds_margin
data_fields.donor_constant: 0 in the fit; CTF flags scaled by 1.1 about the world origin before the bounds grow

best_idea: Fit a zone's bounding box to one square minimap with a single uniform scale (the longer side fills, the shorter side is centred), map every dot and landmark through that one function, and ghost a landmark's home marker while its owner is away.
decision_why: Keep the one-function projection, the square fit and the ghosted home marker; replace the render-to-texture bake with a direct draw of the zone tile grid, and make the margin a fraction of the box size, not of the coordinates.
acceptance: On a zone at 375 wide the whole zone fits the square with the longer side touching both edges; a test maps a known world point to a known pixel within 1 px; a landmark's home marker shows ghosted while its owner is away; no minimap value is sent to the server or used in a hit test.
